text: Yuan Longping was born in Beijing in 1930.
In the 1960s, as the nation was short of food, Mr Yuan began to do research on hybrid rice.
His hybrid rice has fed many people.
Mr Yuan is known as the "Father of Hybrid Rice".
Thomas Edison was born in America in 1847.
He was always interested in new things and he created over 1,000 inventions.
Edison wanted to invent a new light bulb, but it was not easy.
He never gave up and tried thousands of different ways.
His light bulb helps people see in the dark safely and easily.
Now, we can have light all the time, just by turning on a switch.
